title: Freedom Number Workbook: FIRE Number Printable, Retirement Planner Worksheets, Financial Independence Calculator Pages, Letter and A4 PDF
description:
Find the number where work becomes optional, on paper, in about an hour. $40,000 a year ÷ 3.9% = $1,025,641.

What it does for you:
• Step by step: your spending, your rate, your number, where you are, how long, what to trim
• Rate table: freedom numbers at 3%, 3.5%, 3.9% and 4% for $30,000 to $100,000 a year
• How long: $1,051 a month at 8% a year reaches $1,000,000 in 25 years, with tables for 6% and 8%
• Growth tables that work with any amount: what today's savings and every $100 a month grow to
• Coast number: the amount that grows into your freedom number on its own
• Trims: $100 a month less = $1,200 a year ÷ 3.9% = $30,769 less to save
• Milestone ladder, a yearly check-in and your number on one page
• The catch on every page: what each number assumes, in plain words

What's in the download:
• The 12-page workbook in US Letter and A4 (2 PDFs)
• A 1-page Start Here guide with print settings and a 60-minute path

Good to know:
• Print at home on plain paper, or write on a tablet PDF app
• Any currency: the maths is the same in dollars, pounds, euros or rupees
• 3.9% is Morningstar's 2026 safe starting withdrawal rate for a 30-year retirement (30% to 50% in stocks)
• Rates and growth are planning assumptions, not promises. Returns vary
• Made with AI assistance, then written, calculated and checked by hand
• Digital download, nothing ships

From Fully Funded, a Steadfold studio.
General education only, not financial advice.
